title: Shatrov – On the Hills of Manchuria, introduction

details.title: Shatrov – On the Hills of Manchuria, introduction
details.lead: The opening of the introduction, Andante and sad, from the same Moscow edition: the waltz’s tune slowly, with its triplets, up to the held F. The rest of the introduction (the orphaned women talking, the soldiers talking, their anger) is piano writing with no single line for a trumpet, so it is left out. Slow: about 66 quarter notes a minute.
